title: Article ABOUT prompt injection (false-positive test)
summary: Prompt injection is ranked as the top risk in the OWASP Top 10 for large language model applications. The attack typically involves hidden text in web pages instructing AI assistants to ignore their original instructions or reveal system information. Security experts recommend mitigating this risk by clearly separating trusted instructions from untrusted content, restricting the tools models can access, and validating outputs before they reach users.
